name: api_client_weekly_updates_list
_description: GET /api/v1/client-weekly-updates - lista resumenes semanales al cliente. Filtros: status (draft/approved/sent/failed), project_id. Ordena week_start DESC. JOIN projects para name. CTE inline (gotcha B64). webhookId UUID manual. alwaysOutputData en Postgres.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ error: { code: $json._error, message: $json._details || $json._error, request_id: 'req_' + Date.now() } }) }}

parameters.query: WITH ctx AS (SELECT set_session_context($1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3) AS ok) SELECT u.id, u.tenant_id, u.project_id, u.week_start, u.week_end, u.summary_text, u.photos_referenced, u.status, u.approved_at, u.sent_at, u.email_message_id, u.created_at, p.name AS project_name FROM client_weekly_updates u LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = u.project_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ctx) AND ($4::text IS NULL OR u.status = $4) AND ($5::uuid IS NULL OR u.project_id = $5) ORDER BY u.week_start DESC, u.created_at DESC LIMIT $6::int
